text: I now give the floor to his excellency
Khalifa bin Shaheen Mar, Minister of
State at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
of the United Arab Emirates.
In the name of God, the merciful, the
compassionate. Mr. President, our region
and the word are undergoing a period of
rapid transformation marked by
intensifying challenges and divisions.
Against this backdrop, the United Arab
Emirates stands tall, guided by a clear
vision and unwavering determination to
transform challenges into opportunities,
to turn ambitions into achievements, and
to open new horizons for peace,
development, and prosperity for our
people, the peoples of the region, and
the world.
This stems from our principled approach
rooted in deescalation, bridge building,
the promotion of diplomacy and dialogue,
the peaceful settlement of disputes, and
the rejection of the unlawful use or
threat of use of force as well as
coercion. This approach is grounded in
full respect for the sovereignty of
states, good neighborly relations,
international law, and the UN charter.
These values have long underpinned our
domestic and foreign policies.
As Iran continues its occupation of the
three Emirati islands, Greater Tumb,
Lesser Toumb, and Abu Musa, which we
reject, the United Arab Emirates has
consistently called for a peaceful
settlement of this conflict, whether
through direct negotiations or by
recourse to the International Court of
Justice.
Amid growing threats to navigation in
our region and beyond, my country
has continued to emphasize the
principles of freedom of navigation and
the right of transit passage. We
stressed the need to secure and protect
the safe flow of supply chains, trade
and energy in accordance with
international law, including the law of
the sea and the principle of state
sovereignty, recognizing these as
pillars of food security, development,
and prosperity of nations. We have
continued to support every sincere e
effort to achieve peace particularly in
Yemen, Libya, the Sahel, the Democratic
Republic of the Congo, Myanmar, Hayiti
and elsewhere.
We have also supported efforts to reach
a sustainable political solution to the
question of the Moroccan Sahara based on
the Moroccan Autonomy initiative while
affirming the sovereignty of the Kingdom
of Morocco over the Sahara. Furthermore,
we have advocated for a comprehensive,
just, and lasting peace in Ukraine in
accordance with international law and
the principles of the UN charter,
including respect for sovereignty,
independence, and territorial integrity.
We have remained steadfast in our role
as a trusted international mediator,
successfully conducting 26 mediations
that facilitated the exchange of nearly
8,000 prisoners between Ukraine and the
Russian Federation, ensuring their
return to their homelands and families.
The UAE has also stood ready to support
nations undergoing positive
transformations such as Syria and
Lebanon as they move towards a secure
and stable future.
Regarding Sudan,
my country has underscored the need to
end the humanitarian catastrophe,
securing a permanent and unconditional
ceasefire that would bring an end to the
civil war. This includes launching a
comprehensive and credible political
process led by civilians
which would culminate in the formation
of a civil government independent of
both parties to the conflict and from
extremist groups. It is crucial to
ensure that neither side of the conflict
has a role in the new civilian
government. The future of Sudan must be
decided solely by the Sudanis people and
the international community must press
the leaders of Port Sudan authorities
and those of the rapid support forces as
parties to the conflict to engage
seriously with international
initiatives. As for Gaza,
the UAE was among the first to support
the framework established by the
international community to end the
horrific war.
We have stressed the need to fully
implement the comprehensive plan of
President Trump to end the conflict in
Gaza and the associated road map,
including the withdrawal of Israel from
the Gaza Strip, the disarmament of
Hamas, and the advancement of a serious
political horizon leading to a just and
lasting settlement of the Palestinian
question based on the two-state
solution. This entails the establishment
of an independent sovereign Palestinian
state living side by side with Israel in
peace and security.
We also underscore the importance of
ensuring the unification of Gaza and the
West Bank under a Palestinian authority
that once reformed will be capable to
fulfill its responsibilities and ensure
that arms remain solely under its
control. We further underscore the
urgent need to halt Israel's dangerous
escalation in the worst in the West Bank
and its settlement activities
accompanied by the rise of settler
violence, terrorism, and the siege of
Palestinian village as well as the
ongoing violations in East Jerusalem and
at the holy sites and the attempts to
impose a new historical and legal status
quo on the ground. My country strongly
condemns all these actions. For decades,
the UAE's commitment to the Palestinian
people has remained unwavering. Today,
that commitment continues through our
role as the largest provider of
humanitarian aid to Gaza along with our
humanitarian and development projects in
the West Bank.
This role reflects the core values of
our fall foreign policy which is driven
by the spirit of giving through
effective international partnerships
while reconfirming the principles of
international humanitarian law and
protection of civilians.
Across all these dosier, the importance
of developing and reforming regional and
international multilateral institutions
remains paramount to strengthen their
capacity to fulfill their
responsibilities, foremost among them
the UN, including the security council.
the United Nations. As the United
Nations prepares to transition to a new
leadership,
we look forward to the next Secretary
General using his or her good offices to
activate preventive and mediation
mechanisms before the first signs of
crisis emerge rather than merely
reacting once they have erupted. Crisis
should be addressed at their roots, not
simply managed.
Mr. President,
My country has refused to let the crisis
surrounding us undermine the
worldleading achievements we have built
over decades.
We have pressed ahead with progress
across every sector. For this nation was
forged not in the absence of challenges
but in defiance of them. The peoples of
the region aspire to stability and
prosperity in an environment defined by
cooperation, moderation, and tolerance,
not by violence, hatred, extremism or
terrorism.
The UAE model has demonstrated its
resilience and its capacity to deliver
tangible results by investing in key
pillars of national strength. foremost
among them strategic independence,
industrial capabilities, advanced
defense systems and worldclass
infrastructure and logistics.
This is complemented by the empowerment
of human capital, building a knowledge
and innovationbased economy and the
harnessing of the opportunities offered
by the comprehensive economic economic
partnership agreements concluded between
the UAE and 38 nations and other
frameworks to diversify markets and
supply chains and to broaden horizons
for trade and investment.
We will continue to strengthen the UAE's
role as a global hub connecting markets
and capital,
opening ever broader horizons for
growth. This is the promise that the UAE
makes to its people and to all who call
it home. And it is also the bedrock of
our international partnerships,
particularly with the nations of the
global south and the African continent,
which have matured into an enduring
strategic cooperation rooted in mutual
respect and shared interests.
The UAE continues to expand its
investments in artificial intelligence,
emerging technologies, healthcare, and
education.
We are also strengthening our position
as a trusted and responsible leader in
the energy sector, balancing the needs
of today with bold investment in
solutions of tomorrow and driving the
historic commitments of the UAE
consensus toward long-term collective
action.
This year the UAE is preparing to
co-host with Seneagal the UN water
conference
recognizing the importance of concerted
coordinate coordinated international
action in confronting the challenges of
water climate and food security.
We are confident that the conference
will mark a vital milestone in advancing
real practical solutions for water
security. We invite you to participate
in the conference and look forward to
welcoming you in Abu Dhabi.
These efforts
embody our firm commitment
to turning the challenge of water
scarcity into an opportunity for
innovation and joint international
action including through the Muhammad
Benzed Water Initiative which harnesses
innovation, partnership and investment
to deliver lasting sustainable solutions
for present and future generations.
Two days ago, Abu Dhabi also hosted the
opening of the 15th UN Congress on Crime
Prevention and Criminal Justice, which
highlights the need to keep pace with
rapid technological advancement and to
protect societies from the impacts of
crime, violence, and exploitation.
At the same time, we are investing in
the values of tolerance, peaceful
coexistence, and inclusion through
partnerships that bring together diverse
nationalities and religions. We are
building a society in which women
participate fully, equally, and
meaningfully
in which young people are genuine
partners in shaping their future. In
conclusion, Mr. President, my country
will remain committed to the path of
moderation, the rejection of violence
and extremism and the investment in
people and in the vast potential with
which our region is so richly endowed.
We extend our hands to our partners in
the region and the world to build rather
than destroy and to unite rather than
divide. Thank you, President.
I thank
I thank the Minister of State and the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the
United Arab Emirates.
